description: Magic: The Gathering card database CLI: search, prices, rulings, sets, and batch collection valuation against api.scryfall.com (keyless).

novel_features.name: Batch collection valuation
novel_features.description: Price up to 75 cards in one call; the binder/deck-list workflow the API is most used for and the endpoint the community spec was missing.

novel_features.name: Marketplace ID lookup
novel_features.description: Collectors and store owners work in marketplace IDs, not Scryfall UUIDs.

novel_features.name: Compact price-first output
novel_features.description: Name + USD + EUR is the answer; full card JSON on demand.
